scope: Only page256 saved Elementor data after normal scope release. No full save/global/shared/plugin/SMTP/media write.

source_target_contract.protected: all stress copy/list strings, region name, classes and IDs

role_only_transaction.goal: Change only the stress-card tag pair aside -> article while leaving physical child order unchanged.
role_only_transaction.mandatory_precondition: Fresh content/search returns one compact exact af260007 boundary containing BOTH the opening aside tag and its matching closing aside tag and no unrelated aside owner.
role_only_transaction.method: One guarded match-once replacement of that complete compact boundary, changing only the tag names. Do not use two separate opening/closing writes and do not use page-wide replace_all.
abort_if: both tag boundaries cannot be isolated in one exact unique owner slice
another aside occurs inside the selected slice ambiguously
acceptance: card is article and not complementary
visual geometry unchanged before any optional visual CSS

physical_order_blocker.rule: Role-only tag fix never clears reading-order parity.
physical_order_blocker.safe_future_shape: Only a fresh complete af260007 owner may authorize one single owner-level replacement that preserves p1/p2/card bytes but emits the source physical sequence in one transaction. If that complete owner cannot be safely isolated, do not move nodes.
forbidden: JS/CSS reorder counted as semantic PASS

visual_separation: build/bio-stress-current-dom-visual-v003.css remains an independent presentation candidate after carrier/cascade proof; it does not clear physical order.
rollback: Reverse only the same complete post-write boundary with one guarded edit if immediate readback fails.
